arxiv-2101-06716.title: Coherent seeding of the dynamics of a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate: from quantum to classical behavior
arxiv-2101-06716.creator: Bertrand Evrard, An Qu, Jean Dalibard and Fabrice Gerbier
arxiv-2101-06716.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Bertrand Evrard, An Qu, Jean Dalibard and Fabrice Gerbier. We present experiments revealing the competing effect of quantum fluctuations and of a coherent seed in the dynamics of a spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensate, and discuss the relevance of a mean-field description of our system. We first explore a near-equilibrium situation, where the mean-field equations can be linearized around a fixed point corresponding to all atoms in the same Zeeman state m = 0 m=0 .

arxiv-2104-11155.title: Higgs-strahlung boson production in the presence of a circularly polarized laser field
arxiv-2104-11155.creator: M. Ouhammou, M. Ouali, S. Taj, B. Manaut
arxiv-2104-11155.description: Abstract In the framework of the electroweak standard model, we investigated, in the center of mass frame, the Higgs boson production in the presence of an intense laser field via e + ​ e − {e}^{+}{e}^{-} annihilation ( e + ​ e − → Z ​ H ) ({e}^{+}{e}^{-}\rightarrow ZH) .

arxiv-2202-11738.title: Breaking Reflection Symmetry: Evolving Long Dynamical Cycles in Boolean Systems
arxiv-2202-11738.creator: Mathieu Ouellet, Jason Z. Kim, Harmange Guillaume, Sydney M. Shaffer, Lee C. Bassett, Dani S. Bassett
arxiv-2202-11738.description: Abstract In interacting dynamical systems, specific local interaction rules for system components give rise to diverse and complex global dynamics. Long dynamical cycles are a key feature of many natural interacting systems, especially in biology. Examples of dynamical cycles range from circadian rhythms regulating sleep to cell cycles regulating reproductive behavior.

arxiv-2207-02281.title: BiPOCO: Bi-directional Trajectory Prediction with Pose Constraints for Pedestrian Anomaly Detection
arxiv-2207-02281.creator: Asiegbu Miracle Kanu-Asiegbu, Ram Vasudevan, Xiaoxiao Du
arxiv-2207-02281.description: Abstract We present BiPOCO, a Bi-directional trajectory predictor with POse COnstraints, for detecting anomalous activities of pedestrians in videos. In contrast to prior work based on feature reconstruction, our work identifies pedestrian anomalous events by forecasting their future trajectories and comparing the predictions with their expectations.

arxiv-2301-05456.title: Data Quality for Software Vulnerability Datasets
arxiv-2301-05456.creator: Roland Croft 1 2 , M. Ali Babar 1 2 , M. Mehdi Kholoosi 1 2
arxiv-2301-05456.description: Abstract The use of learning-based techniques to achieve automated software vulnerability detection has been of longstanding interest within the software security domain. These data-driven solutions are enabled by large software vulnerability datasets used for training and benchmarking. However, we observe that the quality of the data powering these solutions is currently ill-considered, hindering the reliability and value of produced outcomes.

arxiv-2302-09172.description: Abstract The Cosmic-Ray Veto detector for the muon-to-electron conversion experiment at Fermilab consists of four plastic scintillating counter layers read out by silicon photo-multipliers through embedded wavelength-shifting fibers. In order to increase the light yield in the most critical regions of the Cosmic-Ray Veto detector for improved background rejection, a 1.

arxiv-2305-04590.title: A brief introduction to satellite communications for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN)
arxiv-2305-04590.creator: José Alberto Hernández, Pedro Reviriego
arxiv-2305-04590.description: Abstract At present (year 2023), approximately 2,500 satellites are currently orbiting the Earth. This number is expected to reach 50,000 satellites (that is, 20 times growth) for the next 10 years, thanks to the recent advances concerning launching satellites at low cost and with high probability of success.

arxiv-2403-05484.title: Bayesian mass mapping with weak lensing data using karmma – validation with simulations and application to Dark Energy Survey Year 3 data
arxiv-2403-05484.creator: Supranta S. Boruah, Pier Fiedorowicz, Eduardo Rozo
arxiv-2403-05484.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Supranta S. Boruah, Pier Fiedorowicz, Eduardo Rozo. We update the field-level inference code karmma to enable tomographic forward-modelling of shear maps. Our code assumes a lognormal prior on the convergence field, and properly accounts for the cross-covariance in the lensing signal across tomographic source bins. We use mock weak lensing data from N N -body simulations to validate our mass-mapping forward model by comparing our posterior maps to the input convergence fields. We find that karmma produces more accurate reconstructions than traditional mass-mapping algorithms.

arxiv-2404-06846.title: Register Your Forests : Decision Tree Ensemble Optimization by Explicit CPU Register Allocation
arxiv-2404-06846.creator: Daniel Biebert, Christian Hakert, Kuan-Hsun Chen, Jian-Jia Chen
arxiv-2404-06846.description: Abstract . Bringing high-level machine learning models to efficient and well-suited machine implementations often invokes a bunch of tools, e.g. code generators, compilers, and optimizers. Along such tool chains, abstractions have to be applied. This leads to not optimally used CPU registers. This is a shortcoming, especially in resource constrained embedded setups.

arxiv-2505-00769.title: Quasiparticle-induced decoherence of a driven superconducting qubit
arxiv-2505-00769.creator: Mykola Kishmar, Pavel D. Kurilovich, Andrey Klots, Thomas Connolly, Igor L. Aleiner, Vladislav D. Kurilovich
arxiv-2505-00769.description: Abstract We develop a theory for two quasiparticle-induced decoherence mechanisms of a driven superconducting qubit. In the first mechanism, an existing quasiparticle (QP) tunnels across the qubit’s Josephson junction while simultaneously absorbing a qubit excitation and one (or several) photons from the drive.

arxiv-2506-15320.title: SOT Enabled 3D Magnetic Field Sensor with Low Offset and High Sensitivity
arxiv-2506-15320.creator: Sebastian Zeilinger, Johannes Güttinger, Klemens Prügl, Michael Kirsch, Joshua M. Salazar-Mejía, Sabri Koraltan, Philip Heinrich, Sophie Zeilinger, Bernd Aichner, Florian Bruckner, Hubert Brückl, Armin Satz, Dieter Suess
arxiv-2506-15320.description: Abstract In this work we demonstrate a spin orbit torque (SOT) magnetic field sensor, designed as a Ta/CoFeB/MgO structure, with high sensitivity and capable of active offset compensation in all 3 spatial directions. This is described and verified in experiment and simulation.

arxiv-2508-21721.title: Globally Coupled Particle Swarm Optimization
arxiv-2508-21721.creator: Liguo Yuan a
arxiv-2508-21721.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Liguo Yuan a. All things in the world are interconnected, the only difference is the strength of their connections. Particle swarm optimization(PSO) simulates the foraging behavior of a flock of birds, information is transmitted to quickly find the location of food. This is a process of information exchange, where birds influence each other, constantly adjusting their position and speed values, and updating the optimal position information.

pmc-10590288.title: Missing links exploring transitions
pmc-10590288.creator: Peter Nick
pmc-10590288.description: a central problem of any theory that is considering transformations. Darwin’s friend and mentor, the geologist Charles Lyell, introduced the concept of missing links to explain gaps in the geological record, but soon adopted it to problems of biological evolution, for instance in the transition between apes and humans (Lyell 1863).

pmc-11352955.title: Disparities in Overall Survival Rates for Cancers across Income Levels in the Republic of Korea
pmc-11352955.creator: Su-Min Jeong, Kyu-Won Jung, Juwon Park, Hyeon Ji Lee, Dong Wook Shin, Mina Suh, Shailesh Singh
pmc-11352955.description: Simple SummaryThe study analyzed income disparities in 5-year survival rates (5YSR) among cancer patients in South Korea from 2002 to 2018. Overall, 5YSR improved from 2002–2006 to 2014–2018, particularly for lung, liver, and stomach cancers. The Slope Index of Inequality (SII) indicated significant income-related disparities, with higher survival rates associated with higher incomes, notably for lung and liver cancers.

pmc-11412688.title: Ultrasound-Guided Erector Spinae Plane Block: A Case Series Demonstrating Utility for Acutely Painful Conditions in the Emergency Setting
pmc-11412688.creator: Richard Slama, Julia Lerner, Adrianna Kyle
pmc-11412688.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Ultrasound-guided erector spinae plane block (ESPB) has emerged as a valuable technique in pain management. Though frequently used in chronic and postoperative pain, it remains underutilized in the emergency department (ED) setting. In particular, this block has become attractive because it is rapid, safe, and efficacious for a variety of different pain syndromes that are commonly encountered in the emergency department setting.

pmc-11508824.title: Characteristics of Pinus hwangshanensis Rhizospheric Fungal Community along Huangshan Mountain’s Elevation Gradients, China
pmc-11508824.creator: Qinglin Zuo, Keke Dang, Jing Yin, Dandan Yuan, Jing Lu, Xingjia Xiang, Donald O Natvig
pmc-11508824.description: Elevation gradients strongly influence the diversity pattern of soil microorganisms. To date, many studies have elucidated the response of soil microbes to changes in elevation gradients. However, the effects of these gradients on the assembly mechanisms and network complexity of rhizospheric microbial communities remain underexplored.

pmc-12488558.title: A case report of hepatocarcinoma-originated pericardial malignancy
pmc-12488558.creator: Bin Wu, Zhixiao Wang, Weizhe Lin, Jian Xiong, Chaoyong He
pmc-12488558.description: Cardiac tumors constitute an exceptionally rare neoplastic entity posing significant diagnostic challenges. We report a 55-year-old female patient without prior oncologic history who presented with acute-onset bilateral lower extremity edema progressing over 72 h. Transthoracic echocardiography demonstrated a pericardial mass with concomitant hemorrhagic pericardial effusion.

pmc-12526948.title: Resonant Ultrasound Spectroscopy Detection Using a Non-Contact Ultrasound Microphone
pmc-12526948.creator: Jake Pretula, Nolan Shaw, Ayden Chen, Kyle G. Scheuer, Ray G. DeCorby
pmc-12526948.description: We observed vibrational eigenmodes for a variety of millimeter-scale objects, including glass and sapphire lenses, by placing them on a piezoelectric ‘shaker’ driven by a broadband noise or frequency sweep signal, and using an optomechanical microphone to pick up their vibrational signatures emitted into the surrounding air.

pmc-13117053.title: Red Cell Distribution Width-Standard Deviation Is Associated with Cumulative Metabolic Burden but Not Independently with Metabolic Syndrome
pmc-13117053.creator: Kemal Ozan Lule, Nezihe Otay Lule, Mert Deniz Savcilioglu, Hamit Yildiz
pmc-13117053.description: Background and Objectives: Red cell distribution width (RDW) has been associated with adverse cardiometabolic outcomes; however, whether RDW—particularly RDW standard deviation (RDW-SD)—represents an independent determinant of metabolic syndrome (MetS) or reflects cumulative metabolic burden remains unclear. This study evaluated the association between RDW-SD and MetS presence and examined its relationship with the quantitative accumulation of MetS components.

pmc-13138335.title: Lights up on the embryonic dance: tools and applications of optogenetics in developmental biology
pmc-13138335.creator: Yang Gao, Emily K. Ho, Jared E. Toettcher
pmc-13138335.description: In this review, Gao et al. discuss the recent advances in optogenetics that allow researchers to perform precise, spatiotemporally controlled, mechanistic analyses in developmental biology. While they elaborate on how optogenetic tools have been applied to dissecting developmental cellular processes and dynamics, they also articulate the challenges and future directions for the field.

pmc-13325638.title: High Uric Acid Promotes Stem Leydig Cell Senescence by CCDC90B Mediates Mitochondrial Quality Control Imbalance
pmc-13325638.creator: Jiayu Huang, Ao Wang, Xiangyu Li, Peng Huang, Kaixuan Zeng, Lu Sun, Moxuan Li, Yixiang Chen, Jiancheng Wang
pmc-13325638.description: Hyperuricemia is a common metabolic disease and an important risk factor for low testosterone levels in men. The functional homeostasis of stem Leydig cells (SLCs) is crucial for maintaining testosterone levels. However, the potential molecular mechanism of how high uric acid (UA) levels affect SLC function remains to be elucidated.

pmc-13433210.title: Case Report: Retained gallstone migrating to the chest wall after cholecystectomy presenting as chronic abscess, sinus tract, and inflammatory pseudotumor
pmc-13433210.creator: Weimin Li, Yi Zhao, Wenting Zhou, Zhigang Xiu, Yi Luo, Yubo Kan
pmc-13433210.description: BackgroundGallbladder perforation and gallstone spillage are common during laparoscopic cholecystectomy, occurring in up to 40% and 6%–10% of cases, respectively. While most retained stones remain asymptomatic, 2.3%–8.5% of patients may present with intra-abdominal abscess, granuloma formation, abdominal wall sinus, fistula or a mass mimicking a malignancy (1).

pmc-13561078.title: Using computer games to explore foraging-predation trade-offs and spatial learning in humans
pmc-13561078.creator: Stav Subach, Arik Dorfman, Adi Bar, Tali Potudin, Aziz Subach, Inon Scharf
pmc-13561078.description: Foraging requires organisms to balance energetic gains against multiple costs, including predation risk, while updating decisions as conditions change. Although these processes are well studied in animals, ecologically grounded paradigms for testing behavioural updating and cross-task generalization in humans remain limited.

uslaw-usc-t46-s55115.title: 46 U.S.C. § 55115 — Supplies on fish processing vessels
uslaw-usc-t46-s55115.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s55115.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part D (Promotional Programs); Chapter 551 (Coastwise Trade). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Section 55102 of this title does not apply to supplies aboard a United States documented fish processing vessel that are necessary and used for processing or assembling fishery products aboard such a vessel.
